ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.02:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; surface is >98% dark-toned with minimal high-intensity regions limited to markings and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a solid low-intensity mask. Discrete high-intensity contiguous blobs are localized at the extreme distal-most points of both left and right lobes (approx. 5% of tip area). Minor high-intensity linear marks are distributed across the mid-left and center-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending ~12% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge exhibits irregular serration with a mean peak-to-valley amplitude of 8-15 pixels. Variation frequency is approximately 1 peak per 50 pixels along the linear boundary, becoming more pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a broadly convex mathematical curve from the peduncle attachment point to the distal tips, transitioning to a sharp concavity at the start of the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, high-contrast white pixel clusters (epibiont/barnacle colonies) concentrated on the extreme trailing-edge tips of both lobes; secondary small circular clusters are visible on the left-center ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) primarily on the left lobe (diagonal orientation) and near the right side of the median notch (vertical orientation).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white linear rake marks across the dark pigmentation and dense barnacle colonization at the distal margins of the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Near-total black monochromatic pigmentation across the ventral surface, providing high contrast for specific localized scar patterns.
